pages.text: Wild raspberries were red and ripe in the bushes by the stream. Mom would bake a berry pie today.
"I want to help with a basketful!" Mumu took his basket. Mom said, "The sunny side ripens first."
Dodo shook her head. "No, the big berries hide deep inside the bush. I know!"
She rustled deep into the bushes.
"Ouch! Prickle!" Thorns tugged her feathers. Dodo was stuck.
Only her voice came from inside. "The thorns here... are bigger than the berries!"
Mumu picked only red berries along the sunny edge. Pick, pick. His basket steadily filled with red.
Mumu held both of Dodo's feet and pulled. Heave—out! One berry was stuck among her ruffled feathers.
In the kitchen, Mom rinsed that berry and put it on the pie dough. Dodo's berry sat right on top.
The pie came out golden. "You know, I found the berry on top!" At Dodo's words, everyone laughed and ate a slice.
